title: The Strong Naor--Schechtman Convolution Inequality on the Product of Cyclic Groups
summary: In this paper, we resolve the convolution inequality problem posed by Naor and Schechtman in \cite[Question 6.1]{N-S2016} (see also \cite{Na2016}).
